sections.#feature-bullets: About this item FEEL ENERGIZED: SuperBeets Heart Powder is a clinically studied beetroot powder scientifically formulated to help increase Nitric Oxide production and support healthy blood flow, circulation, boost endurance and added energy without caffeine or stimulants. SUPPORTS HEALTHY BLOOD PRESSURE: Clinically-studied, verified Nitric Oxide booster with advanced, patented beets supplements to support healthy blood pressure, blood flow, overall heart health, and support endurance, and can act as a caffeine-free pre-workout. DELICIOUS BLACK CHERRY FLAVOR: Enjoy the Nitric Oxide boosting benefits beets, zero beet flavor. Mix the beet powder in 4-6 oz. of water to activate the circulation superfood benefits. NON-GMO, HIGH QUALITY: Made from 100% non-GMO beets sourced from renowned growing regions and tested for efficacy and purity as a beet supplement. Only 1 in 10 beets meets our quality standards. INCREASED NITRIC OXIDE PRODUCTION: Clinically studied formula features patented Nitric Oxide technology that’s verified to generate Nitric Oxide more effectively & efficiently than other standard beetroot supplements, beet root capsules, and beets powder. sections.#important-information: Important information Safety Information Important Information: For adult use only. Consult a physician or qualified healthcare professional if pregnant/nursing, taking medication (blood pressure, anticoagulants, or blood thinning medication) or have a medical condition. This product does not contain any known allergens. Discontinue use and contact your physician if you have sensitivities or are allergic to beet root powder. Additionally, if you experience any adverse reactions such as abdominal pain, rash, migraines, headaches, or other, please stop taking this product immediately and contact your physician. Store in a cool, dry location. Refrigeration is not necessary. Avoid exposure to moisture. To find the expiry date, please check the bottom of the canister. Best when used within 45 days of opening. Do not use if it's past the expiry date. Indications Circulation, energy and blood pressure support Ingredients Black Cherry Flavor Ingredients: Non-GMO Beetroot Powder, Non-GMO Beetroot Powder (fermented), Natural Black Cherry Flavor, Malic Acid, Magnesium Ascorbate, Stevia Leaf Extract. Directions Mix one teaspoon per day of SuperBeets soluble crystals with at least 4-6 ounces of liquid: i.e. water, fruit juice, a smoothie, etc. Each canister contains 30 servings and should be stored in a cool, dry location. Refrigeration is not necessary. Avoid exposure to moisture. Once opened, SuperBeets Crystals are best used within 45 days. Legal Disclaimer Warning, this product does not mix easily. It works best when you put it in a blender with your favorite Juice Blend or Protein Shake. Once opened, limit exposure to Moisture and use the product within 30 days. The product may become hard otherwise.
